briefTitle: Prospective Study on Radiation Induced Cardiotoxicity Assessed By PET-CT for Locally Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

typedChecks.sourceText: Stage III NSCLC per AJCC 8th edition guideline, confirmed by pathological diagnosis and PET/CT.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Stage III NSCLC per AJCC 8th edition guideline, confirmed by pathological diagnosis and PET/CT.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Ability to provide written informed consent and HIPAA authorization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ability to provide consent is a subjective participant capability, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: To receive standard definitive concurrent chemoradiation therapy per NCCN guidelines.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Treatment plan requirement is not a standard eligibility criterion kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumor estimated to be within 2cm of heart contour or anticipated MHD>10Gy per treating physician.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Physician estimation of tumor distance and dose is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients treated with stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior SBRT exclusion is context-specific to prior treatment history that is best left as fuzzy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of a severe anaphylactic reaction to iodinated contrast.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Allergy severity is a clinical judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Inability to hold breath for more than 5 seconds.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Physical capability to hold breath is a subjective test requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients on radioactive iodine therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent therapy exclusion is not covered by allowed typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Second-degree AV block, third-degree AV block, and sinus node disease (such as sick sinus syndrome or symptomatic bradycardia) without a functioning pacemaker.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiac conduction disorders are not simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with bronchospastic diseases including asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) who have an acute exacerbation or active wheezing (a high-pitched, musical, adventitious lung sound produced by airflow through the narrowed airways) on the day of PET CT exam.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active wheezing and acute exacerbation are subjective physical exam findings on the day of the test.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who are hypotensive (systolic blood pressure less than 90 mm Hg) on the day of the PET/CT scan.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Blood pressure on the day of the scan is a procedural condition rather than a baseline screening lab.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tumor estimation and physician discretion regarding radiation dose are subjective medical judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients treated with stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Refers to treatment modality or procedural history context.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Allergic history to contrast is procedure-specific rather than a standard organ function typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Inability to hold breath for more than 5 seconds.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Physical capability/compliance is a functional judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients on radioactive iodine therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific concurrent therapy exclusion not covered by standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Second-degree AV block, third-degree AV block, and sinus node disease (such as sick sinus syndrome or symptomatic bradycardia) without a functioning pacemaker.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiac conduction abnormalities are specific clinical exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with bronchospastic diseases including asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) who have an acute exacerbation or active wheezing (a high-pitched, musical, adventitious lung sound produced by airflow through the narrowed airways) on the day of PET CT exam.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinical exacerbation and physical exam findings are subjective and date-dependent.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who are hypotensive (systolic blood pressure less than 90 mm Hg) on the day of the PET/CT scan.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Blood pressure reading on the day of scan is a dynamic clinical measurement.
